quote.text: Whatever anyone does or says, I must be emerald and keep my colour.
quote.author: Marcus Aurelius
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Like the steadfast emerald, nurture your children with unwavering consistency; let your inner virtues shine irrespective of external distractions.
    • Embrace challenges as opportunities to model resilience, showing your children that true character remains vibrant regardless of the opinions or actions of others.
  • Leadership
    • Remain true to your principles even when faced with turbulence; a leader's strength lies in preserving integrity despite the noise around.
    • Lead with a clear purpose, letting the brilliance of your core values guide decisions, much like an emerald retains its purity amid changing circumstances.
  • Product Management
    • In the fast-paced market, hold steadfast to your vision and values, ensuring that the product’s essence remains consistent and undiluted.
    • Balance external input with an unwavering commitment to quality and purpose, much like an emerald that remains true to its color despite external pressures.
